title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Maractus SV4K Ancient Roar 003/066 Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This is a Japanese Pokémon TCG card featuring the character Maractus. It is a Stage 1 Pokémon with a Common rarity, part of the Ancient Roar series. The card has a Holo finish and is numbered 003/066. It is not autographed or graded, and is recommended for ages 4 and up. Created by Nintendo, this card is part of the SV4K collection.
